blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Some universities in Metro Manila will shift to online classes on Wednesday, Nov. 25 amid the extended transportation strike by transport group Manibela. Manibela earlier announced that it will extend its protest and strike in Metro Manila until Nov. 25 to continue protesting the replacement of Land Transportation Office (LTO) chief Assistant Secretary Markus Lacanilao. READ: Manibela extending protest, strike until Wednesday So far, the following schools have suspended in-person classes to alleviate the burden on commuting students.
